programmes.programName: Doutorado Acadêmico em Administração de Empresas (CDAE)
programmes.school: Escola de Administração de Empresas de São Paulo
programmes.evidence: Official academic doctorate requires selecting one of six research lines at admission and developing final research within it. GOS explicitly covers operations management and strategy, organizational performance, competitiveness and sustainability. Exact academic research credential read in expanded certification; no professional DBA equivalence inferred.

researchDoctorateEvidence.evidence: Official page explicitly calls CDAE academic doctorate, trains scientific researchers and university teachers, provides advisor/research-line structure and doctoral theses, and awards Doutor(a) em Administração de Empresas in expanded certification.

limitations: Academic research credential retained in Portuguese; not silently recoded PhD or professional DBA. Exact doctoral line-to-department administrative hosting not established, so department field and unit link remain unassigned.

branches.conclusion: EAESP current academic doctorate and complete six-line inventory establish eligible GOS doctoral research line.
Other schools of parent Fundação Getulio Vargas and possible mathematical/technical doctoral OR provision remain unchecked; business-school identity not treated as absence across entire foundation.

sources.note: Official school page expands EAESP as Escola de Administração de Empresas de São Paulo da Fundação Getulio Vargas and explicitly enumerates Departamento de Administração da Produção e Operações among teaching departments.

Full current academic doctorate and six mandatory research-line choices read, including Gestão de Operações e Sustentabilidade. Expanded Certificação Emitida explicitly awards Doutor(a) em Administração de Empresas; page describes scientific researcher training, advisor/research line and doctoral theses. Academic CDAE is separate from professional doctorate, not translated to DBA.

limitations: Other FGV schools and relevant technical doctorates need review.
